title: Paper outline + first-reader story + paragraph specs

venue.description: Target conference/journal (e.g. USENIX Security, CSS, NeurIPS)

field.description: cs-security | ml | biomedical | humanities | other — selects field-aware guardrails

story.description: One paragraph for a first-time in-field-but-not-subfield reader: problem -> why it matters -> what we did -> what we found -> so what.

beat.description: Which story beat this section advances

reader_question.description: The question the reader holds when arriving here

question_origin.description: Which earlier section raised that question (or 'unmotivated')

message.description: The single contestable claim this paragraph makes

support_citation_ids.description: Stable ids into the citation pool (citation.schema.json)

support_data.description: Non-citation evidence (a figure, a number, an experiment)

human_authored.description: True for synthesis-heavy paragraphs the human drafts; the skill only comments
